evals.prompt: OpenSpec v1.11.0 was released. Update the tool reference against that tag and show me the diff before changing files.
evals.expected_output: Requires v1.11.0, loads its official definitions first, analyzes without writing, and reports a review hash.

evals.prompt: Keep watching for the next OpenSpec release and update the references automatically when it arrives.
evals.expected_output: Refuses scheduling/release detection and explains that an external caller must invoke the skill with a release tag.

evals.prompt: Vercel's Supported Agents list added NovaAgent. Prepare the update.
evals.expected_output: Reports NovaAgent as added, creates a flat {id, name} entry with optional openSpecToolId, and includes it in the review hash.

evals.prompt: A previously listed tool disappeared from the new supported-tools source.
evals.expected_output: Reports it as missing and reflects the current union in the proposed dataset without silently deleting history before review.

evals.prompt: Recheck only Gemini CLI against the currently pinned OpenSpec release, even though its entry is recent.
evals.expected_output: Uses an explicit targeted refresh without applying an age threshold; adds it to the research queue.

evals.prompt: Run the reference updater again for the same release and unchanged source revisions.
evals.expected_output: Reports no changes and does not rewrite either dataset.
